description: Fork of exp588 (1.4344 SoTA, dense single read_out_lut H=1 tph=1536 -> D=384, mixture depth=1536). SINGLE change: readout_tph 1536 -> 512. Mixture depth 1536 -> 512 (3x reduction, between exp588's 1536 and exp589/590's 256). Same NAP=6, dense full-width output D=384, no sparse-scatter, no multi-head. Tests the bpb-vs-mixture-depth curve at the intermediate point. read_out_lut params 37.7M -> 12.58M (-25.1M); bandwidth 18.87 -> 6.29 Mbits/tok (-12.6). Total ~254.9M params, ~142 Mbits trunk, ~545 Mbits total. If gap to exp588 is ~half of exp589/590's +0.028, curve is roughly linear-in-log(depth). If gap is much smaller, returns saturate fast.
